chapters.title: Welcome to Django 🐍
chapters.description: Kickstart your journey into Django, the high-level Python web framework. Learn what Django is, set up your environment, and create your first project.

chapters.title: Models & Databases 🗄️
chapters.description: Design your data models, understand ORM, and interact with databases using Django's powerful abstraction.

chapters.title: Views & URL Routing 🌐
chapters.description: Connect user requests to Python functions. Learn function-based views, URL patterns, and how to return responses.

chapters.title: Templates & Static Files 🎨
chapters.description: Build dynamic HTML pages, use Django's template language, and manage CSS, JavaScript, and images.

chapters.title: Forms & User Input 📝
chapters.description: Handle user‑submitted data securely with Django forms, validation, and CSRF protection.

chapters.title: The Admin Interface 🛠️
chapters.description: Unlock Django's automatic admin site – customize and manage your data effortlessly.

chapters.title: Authentication & Authorization 🔐
chapters.description: Add user registration, login, logout, and permission systems to your app.

chapters.title: Class‑Based Views 🧩
chapters.description: Leverage Django's powerful class‑based views to write less code and reuse common patterns.

chapters.title: REST Framework Basics 🌍
chapters.description: Build APIs with Django REST Framework – serializers, viewsets, and routers.

chapters.title: Testing & Debugging 🐞
chapters.description: Write unit tests, use Django’s test client, and debug like a pro.

chapters.title: Deployment & Security ☁️
chapters.description: Prepare your app for production – environment variables, static files, security best practices.

chapters.title: Advanced Topics 🧠
chapters.description: Signals, middleware, custom commands, and performance tuning.
